# Pruner Stage + PHASE_TEST Template Revision - Global Documentation

## Feature Overview

**Purpose**: Introduce a deletion-only review stage (pruner agent) into the code workflow, and revise the test template and validators to prevent PRs from being artificially inflated.

**Problem**: PRs generated by the flow are repeatedly larger than the logic warrants. A real example: a +974-line PR contained ~60 lines of logic, 811 lines of tests, and a single trigger function's docstring spanning 34 lines. Root causes:
1. `templates/PHASE_TEST.md` incentivizes "more": per-function unit slots, per-scenario integration slots, generic Edge Cases lists, and a 70% coverage pass/fail gate. Designer fills the slots; coder implements every filled slot.
2. Validation checks "does it pass?" not "is it needed?". `code-validator` only verifies checklists and quality. `spec-validator` has been observed adding tests on the basis of SPEC wording.
3. The same behavior is duplicated across layers (unit + endpoint): gate rejection, cooldown, exception isolation, etc.
4. Design discussion leaks into docstrings (GLOBAL.md rationale copied verbatim into code docstrings).
5. There is no slimming pass after GREEN.

**Solution**: Introduce a pruner at two points. (1) Design stage (doc mode): immediately after TechnicalWriter generates PHASE_TEST/PLAN documents and before the design commit, pruner (doc mode) runs to block inflation at plan time. (2) Code stage (code mode): absorbed into the `code-validator` internal loop — after PASS, pruner (code mode) runs once; if candidates exist, coder applies (test delete/merge and docstring/comment trim only, no logic changes), then a single re-validation pass. Orchestrator flow files (`commands/code.md`, `commands/start-new.md`) are not externally changed. Simultaneously, `templates/PHASE_TEST.md` is revised and the 70% coverage gate is demoted to a reference figure.

## Architecture Decisions

### AD-1: `agents/pruner.md` Frontmatter
```yaml
---
name: pruner
model: claude-sonnet-4-6
description: Analyze and report deletion/merge candidates for tests and docstring/comment trim candidates. Report-only, never modifies files.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash
---
```
- The `tools:` field is supported by Claude Code subagent frontmatter (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents). Pruner is the first agent in this repo to use it.
- The agent body must explicitly prohibit file modification via Bash: `sed -i`, `>`/`>>` redirects, `tee`, `mv`, `cp` (writes), `patch`, `git checkout -- <path>`, `git restore`, `git stash`, `git reset --hard`.

### AD-2: Model Assignment = `claude-sonnet-4-6`
Per `docs/AGENT_MODEL_GUIDE.md` Decision Matrix: checklist-driven judgment and cross-reference analysis, same tier as `code-validator` and `spec-validator`; no code generation required. A row is added to the "Current Assignments" table.

### AD-3: code-validator ↔ pruner ↔ coder Wiring (FR-2b)
A new sub-section "Post-PASS Pruning Pass" is inserted in `agents/code-validator.md` inside the Validate-Fix Loop, after the loop reaches GREEN and BEFORE "Step 3: Document Update":
1. `Task(subagent_type="dotclaude:pruner", prompt="Mode: code. ...")` with the phase's source + test files; primary criteria 2/5/7, plus newly introduced criteria 1/3/4/6 violations.
2. Zero candidates → go straight to Document Update (edge case #1).
3. ≥1 candidate → back up every file named in the report into a temp dir created with `mktemp -d` (record path list), and record `git status --porcelain` output.
4. `Task(subagent_type="{coder_namespace}", prompt="Apply pruner report: delete/merge tests + trim docstrings/comments only. No logic changes, no production code changes, no PLAN checklist changes.")`
5. Out-of-scope guard: compare `git status --porcelain` with the recorded one; any file changed that is not in the report's file list → treat as revalidation failure.
6. Single revalidation pass (lint/type/test).
   - GREEN → delete temp backup, proceed to Document Update with pruned state.
   - RED (or guard failure) → restore the backed-up files (revert/delete any out-of-scope changes), proceed to Document Update returning the pre-pruning GREEN result as PASS.
7. The section must contain the sentence: "The pruning revalidation is a SINGLE pass. It is EXCLUDED from the max-3 retry budget." (edge cases #3, #11)
8. Revert mechanism is file backup/restore only. `git stash`, `git reset --hard`, and `git checkout -- <path>` are FORBIDDEN for this purpose.
- `Test coverage: {X}%` at `agents/code-validator.md:225` stays unchanged (out of scope).

### AD-4: Doc-Mode Insertion (FR-2a) — Visible Step Count Unchanged
- `commands/start-new.md` Step 7 (~lines 310-318): after TechnicalWriter creates GLOBAL/PHASE_*_PLAN/PHASE_*_TEST, call `Task(subagent_type="dotclaude:pruner", prompt="Mode: doc. Targets: PHASE_*_TEST.md + PHASE_*_PLAN.md")`; zero candidates → Step 8; else `Task(subagent_type="dotclaude:technical-writer", prompt="Apply pruner doc-mode report ...; keep ≥1 test per behavior (edge case #10)")` then Step 8.
- `commands/design.md` Step 3 ASCII box (~lines 23-33): same sub-flow; Step numbers 1–5 unchanged.
- README.md 13-Step Workflow table unchanged.

### AD-5: `/dotclaude:prune` Command Registration
`commands/*.md` files are auto-registered; `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` has only name/version/description — no change needed. Add one row to the README.md command table (~lines 143-163):

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/dotclaude:prune [target]` | Analyze current diff or target (phase id / PR / issue / Jira key) and report deletion/merge candidates. Report-only. |

(README row is part of Phase 2 since FR-5 introduces the command; CHANGELOG is Step 11.)

### AD-6: Criterion 1 English Text for `agents/pruner.md`
The following text preserves the exact meaning of SPEC.md:54-58:
```
1. **Branch combinations are verified at exactly one layer.** Verifying the SAME
   FEATURE at multiple layers is permitted. What is forbidden is REPEATING at a
   higher layer branch combinations already verified at a lower layer.
   - The set of branch cases in branching logic (each rejection / exception /
     boundary branch) is verified at only one layer (typically unit).
   - Higher-layer tests (endpoint / scenario / integration) are limited to:
     wiring (does the lower logic actually get invoked and connected),
     response contract (status code / response schema), query count,
     representative flows (1 happy path + 1 representative failure path per
     distinct response-contract failure).
   - Deletion candidate: a higher-layer test that steps outside the above scope
     and re-verifies a lower-layer branch combination (e.g., three cooldown
     branches already covered at unit are re-verified at endpoint with the same
     response contract).
   - NOT a deletion candidate: a unit test plus a scenario test coexisting for
     the same feature (as long as the scenario stays within the scope above).
```

### AD-7: `/dotclaude:prune` Argument Resolution Order
1. Empty → `git diff HEAD` (staged+unstaged), code mode; empty diff → "Nothing to analyze." and exit (edge #6).
2. Phase id matching `^\d+[A-Z]?$` or `^\d+\.\d+$` → that phase's changes, code mode; if phase has no code yet → doc mode on PHASE_{k}_TEST.md + PHASE_{k}_PLAN_*.md.
3. GitHub: PR URL or `#N` resolving to a PR → `gh pr diff N`; issue URL or `#N` resolving to an issue → linked PR or branch → diff vs `base_branch`. Code mode.
4. Jira key matching `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+$` → branch containing the key → diff vs `base_branch`. Code mode.
5. No match / no branch or PR found → report error and exit; never guess (edge #8).

Path argument is unsupported in this iteration. Report-only; applying needs a separate explicit user instruction (edge #9).

## Data Model

No runtime data model changes. All changes are Markdown documents (`agents/*.md`, `commands/*.md`, `templates/*.md`, `docs/*.md`, `README.md`).

## Verification Method

No executable test suite exists in this repository (Markdown plugin). Quality tool detection: N/A. Each phase is verified entirely by the grep/read checks specified in PHASE_*_TEST.md. Coverage: N/A (70% is a reference figure, not a gate, per FR-3).
